src/browser-local-loader.ts.name: Open local file
src/browser-local-loader.ts.description: Wires the Open file button and page-wide drag and drop so a single index.html opens in a new napplet tab.

src/browser-nip5d-host.ts.name: NIP-5D message router
src/browser-nip5d-host.ts.description: Passes each frame's one-time hello to the bridge, logs NAP traffic on bound ports, and removes or replaces frames whose binding is revoked.

src/browser-target-diagnostics.ts.name: Target CORS warning
src/browser-target-diagnostics.ts.description: Asks the Paja server whether the target dev server blocks the sandboxed frame's null origin and, if so, writes the cause and fix to the message log and console.

src/browser-target-frame.ts.name: Sandboxed frame loader
src/browser-target-frame.ts.description: Gives each napplet a fresh iframe, fixes its identity and shell environment before it runs, and loads its bytes via srcdoc.

src/local-target.ts.name: Local file target
src/local-target.ts.description: Turns a dropped index.html into a napplet target, reading its napplet-id and requested domains, and warns about relative assets.

src/runtime-resolver.ts.name: Napplet pointer resolver
src/runtime-resolver.ts.description: Decodes an naddr or nevent pointer, fetches the napplet manifest from relays, verifies the bytes and adds Kehto's strict CSP.
